mapper.select: SELECT q.qna_id, q.member_id, q.qna_category_id, q.qna_title, q.qna_content, q.qna_status, q.is_deleted, q.qna_created_at, q.qna_updated_at, qc.qna_category_name, -- 카테고리 한글명 m.member_name, -- 작성자 이름 qa.qna_answer_content, -- 관리자 답변 내용 qa.qna_answer_created_at -- 관리자 답변 일시 FROM qna q LEFT JOIN qna_category qc ON q.qna_category_id = qc.qna_category_id LEFT JOIN member m ON q.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN qna_answer qa ON q.qna_id = qa.qna_id WHERE q.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY q.qna_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna ( member_id, qna_category_id, qna_title, qna_content, qna_status, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{qnaCategoryId}, #{qnaTitle}, #{qnaContent}, 'WAITING', 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE qna SET is_deleted = 1, qna_updated_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
UPDATE qna SET qna_category_id = #{qnaCategoryId}, qna_title = #{qnaTitle}, qna_content = #{qnaContent}, qna_updated_at = NOW() WHERE qna_id = #{qnaId}
